# Test concurrent execution scenarios

env PE_TEST_MODE=true

# Test concurrent run commands
exec pe run "prompt 1" &
exec pe run "prompt 2" &
exec pe run "prompt 3" &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrent eval with shared config
exec cat > concurrent-config.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Concurrent evaluation test"
prompts:
  - "Test prompt 1"
  - "Test prompt 2"
  - "Test prompt 3"
providers:
  - name: "mock"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Mock"
EOF

# Run multiple evaluations concurrently
exec pe eval concurrent-config.yaml --max-concurrency 3 &
exec pe eval concurrent-config.yaml --max-concurrency 2 &
exec pe eval concurrent-config.yaml --max-concurrency 1 &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test file access concurrency
exec cat > shared-file.txt <<'EOF'
Shared content for concurrent access
EOF

# Multiple processes reading the same file
exec pe run shared-file.txt &
exec pe run shared-file.txt &
exec pe run shared-file.txt &
exec pe run shared-file.txt &
exec pe run shared-file.txt &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test cache concurrency
mkdir -p .pe/cache
exec pe run "cacheable prompt 1" &
exec pe run "cacheable prompt 2" &
exec pe run "cacheable prompt 3" &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test template variable concurrency
exec pe run "Hello {{.name}}" --var name=Alice &
exec pe run "Hello {{.name}}" --var name=Bob &
exec pe run "Hello {{.name}}" --var name=Charlie &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test provider concurrency
exec pe run "test 1" --provider mock &
exec pe run "test 2" --provider cgpt &
exec pe run "test 3" --provider mock &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrent streaming
exec pe run "stream test 1" --stream &
exec pe run "stream test 2" --stream &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrent eval with different configs
exec cat > config1.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Config 1"
prompts: ["prompt 1"]
providers: [{"name": "mock"}]
tests: [{"vars": {}, "assert": [{"type": "contains", "value": "Mock"}]}]
EOF

exec cat > config2.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Config 2"
prompts: ["prompt 2"]
providers: [{"name": "mock"}]
tests: [{"vars": {}, "assert": [{"type": "contains", "value": "Mock"}]}]
EOF

exec pe eval config1.yaml &
exec pe eval config2.yaml &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test memory-intensive concurrent operations
exec pe run "memory test 1" &
exec pe run "memory test 2" &
exec pe run "memory test 3" &
exec pe run "memory test 4" &
exec pe run "memory test 5" &
wait
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrent file creation/deletion
exec pe run "test" > output1.txt &
exec pe run "test" > output2.txt &
exec pe run "test" > output3.txt &
wait

exists output1.txt
exists output2.txt
exists output3.txt
! stderr 'error'

# Test process cleanup
# Ensure no orphaned processes remain
exec ps aux | grep '[p]e' | wc -l
stdout '0'

# Cleanup
rm -f output*.txt config*.yaml shared-file.txt
rm -rf .pe
